data.name: MWG_001
data.value: The summit...[pause=15] We're almost there.

data.name: MWG_002
data.value: Look at the sky...[pause=15] Those clouds aren't normal.

data.name: MWG_003
data.value: Is that...[pause=10] a storm?!

data.name: MWG_004
data.value: It is...[pause=15] Tornadus.[pause=20] The spirit of the winds.

data.name: MWG_005
data.value: I am the Breath that guards the summit...

data.name: MWG_006
data.value: You...[pause=10] You knew it was here!

data.name: MWG_007
data.value: I am this mountain's ultimate guardian.[pause=20] I have ruled these skies since long before anyone set foot on this land.

data.name: MWG_008
data.value: If you triumph here, the path to the ancestral ruins will open to you.

data.name: MWG_009
data.value: Fail...[pause=30] and your journey ends here.

data.name: MWG_010
data.value: Then let's show it our journey is just beginning![pause=10] {0}, let's do this!

data.name: MWG_011
data.value: This time, we take it down.[pause=15] I promise, {0}.

data.name: MWG_012
data.value: We...[pause=10] We beat it!

data.name: MWG_013
data.value: Look![pause=10] The storm is clearing...

data.name: MWG_014
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It said something about ancestral ruins.

data.name: MWG_015
data.value: That's where we're going.[pause=20] To the shattered ruins.

data.name: MWG_016
data.value: Then let's go![pause=15] The end of the expedition awaits us!

data.name: MWG_017
data.value: I hold nothing back...

data.name: MWG_018
data.value: But today's prey is tomorrow's hunter.

data.name: MWG_019
data.value: Rest now.[pause=30] The summit will wait for you.

data.name: MWG_020
data.value: I...[pause=5] I can't stand anymore...[pause=15] The wind is too strong!

data.name: MWG_021
data.value: Tornadus raises one hand.[pause=15] The whole sky leans with it.

data.name: MWG_022
data.value: You are not the first to fall,[pause=20] little climber.[pause=25] And you won't be the last.

data.name: MWG_023
data.value: It rises back into the storm with two wingbeats.[pause=20] The mountain still trembles.

data.name: MWG_024
data.value: Tornadus sinks to one knee.[pause=15] The gusts drop all at once.

data.name: MWG_025
data.value: Tornadus looks at you, breathing hard.[pause=20] Then he bows his head.

data.name: MWG_026
data.value: You have defeated the king of these skies.[pause=25] I... I never thought I'd see this.[pause=30] Go. The summit is yours.

data.name: MWG_027
data.value: It spreads its wings one last time and disappears into the clouds.[pause=15] Silence returns.

data.name: MWG_028
data.value: We...[pause=10] WE BEAT IT![pause=15] The summit is ours!

data.name: MWG_029
data.value: The keeper of the winds bows before you.[pause=25] You are changing the rules of this world.

data.name: MWG_030
data.value: That storm isn't weather. It's been waiting for us.

data.name: MWG_031
data.value: Whatever lands here, we don't run. Agreed?

data.name: MWG_032
data.value: Agreed. Though my legs may need convincing.

data.name: MWG_033
data.value: I remember a sky without climbers in it.

data.name: MWG_034
data.value: Then it's had a long time to get used to disappointment.

data.name: MWG_035
data.value: It folds its wings. The storm folds with it.

data.name: MWG_036
data.value: We came up here for the expedition. I'd forgotten that.

data.name: MWG_037
data.value: So had I. Somewhere on the way it became something else.

data.name: MWG_R01
data.value: The wind is still just as sharp up here.[pause=20] But the sky is empty.

data.name: MWG_R02
data.value: (No shadow crossing the sun.[pause=15] No cry against the rock.)

data.name: MWG_R03
data.value: He must be nesting higher up now.[pause=20] Somewhere we'll never reach.

data.name: MWG_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: MWG_038
data.value: I saw you from the ridge.[pause=25] Two specks, climbing badly.

data.name: MWG_039
data.value: I have watched this land from above since before it had roads.

data.name: MWG_040
data.value: From up there you stop seeing places.[pause=25] You start seeing shapes.

data.name: MWG_041
data.value: And there is a shape under your world, little ones.[pause=30] It has corners.

data.name: MWG_042
data.value: Nothing natural has corners.

data.name: MWG_043
data.value: I have carried that on my back for a very long time.[pause=30] Show me you can carry it too.

data.name: MWG_044
data.value: Then it is yours now.[pause=30] I am glad. It was heavy.

data.name: MWG_045
data.value: Go down. Sleep. Eat something.[pause=25] Nobody solves a shape on an empty stomach.

data.name: MWG_046
data.value: And when you find the corners —[pause=30] do not assume they were built to keep you OUT.

data.name: MWG_047
data.value: Do you hear that silence?[pause=15] It is the first time the summit has fallen quiet.

data.name: MWG_048
data.value: I watched you fall.[pause=15] I watched you climb back up.[pause=25] It is not strength that opens my sky —[pause=10] it is never stopping.

data.name: MWG_049
data.value: You...[pause=10] you were waiting for us,[pause=10] weren't you?[pause=15] All along.

data.name: MWG_050
data.value: I was waiting for someone who can carry. You carry. That is all.

data.name: MWG_051
data.value: (A shape beneath the world...[pause=15] He said nothing natural has angles.)

data.name: MWG_052
data.value: That shape...[pause=15] you said it has angles.[pause=20] Where is it?

data.name: MWG_053
data.value: Veins run beneath the earth,[pause=15] like sick roots.[pause=20] They all converge toward the north.

data.name: MWG_054
data.value: There,[pause=10] ruins shattered by something older than the wind.[pause=25] That is where the shape surfaces.

data.name: MWG_055
data.value: It is not a monster you must fear, little ones.[pause=20] It is a place.[pause=15] And places,[pause=10] well,[pause=10] they are never in a hurry.

data.name: MWG_056
data.value: Then we head down.[pause=15] The Shattered Ruins,[pause=10] that way.[pause=20] And we go.

data.name: MWG_057
data.value: (The veins...[pause=15] They converge toward the north.[pause=20] Toward the Shattered Ruins.[pause=10] That's where we're going.)
